#7924 worker-origin probe — partial evidence, 2026-09-12

Todd manually loaded the prepared temporary extension and executed the two read-only console calls after Chrome browser automation rejected the extension-management URL. The following worker records were returned verbatim by Todd. They are worker-origin observations, not inferred from page access.

```json
{"capture":"sessionShapeWorkerOrigin","capturedAt":"2026-09-12T18:11:45.447Z","origin":"worker","host":"store.tcgplayer.com","path":"/admin/pricing","method":"GET","status":200,"redirected":false,"finalHost":"store.tcgplayer.com","bodyKind":"html","csvRowCount":null,"antiForgeryFieldPresent":true,"jsonTopLevelKeys":[],"unknown":[]}
```

```json
{"capture":"exportWorkerOrigin","capturedAt":"2026-09-12T18:11:47.485Z","origin":"worker","host":"store.tcgplayer.com","path":"/Admin/Pricing/DownloadMyExportCSV","method":"GET","status":200,"redirected":false,"finalHost":"store.tcgplayer.com","bodyKind":"csv","csvRowCount":27389,"antiForgeryFieldPresent":false,"jsonTopLevelKeys":[],"unknown":[]}
```

Fresh page-origin comparison at `2026-09-12T18:10:57.656Z`: clicking Export From Live emitted GET `/Admin/Pricing/DownloadMyExportCSV?type=Pricing`, no POST body, no redirect, HTTP 200, MIME `text/csv`. Chrome's armed download event received the CSV file. The private download `TCGplayer__MyPricing_20260912_021057.csv` contains 27,389 rows, SHA-256 `13895aa83cda70a9bf291d906add945fbf3928166e5e1a6814ffd075389b027d`. Request query field name: `type`. Thus worker replay independently returned CSV bytes despite the page's download navigation. Equality of row counts is observed; byte equality across the two moments was not tested.

Export is worker-sufficient for this session. Import verdict remains pending the canary and revert. Anti-forgery field presence alone does not establish token necessity.

Initial manifest SHA-256: `f57b6d7b697f2ed23840db8d44c6e65291c6bbf7a6af0988c2d0c81c653970ce`. Initial worker SHA-256: `08f1013e260b9a002dea316231a24b1477b7269af83e406b653ca830028bcbda`. Host permissions contain only store.tcgplayer.com and sellerportal.tcgplayer.com; no cookies permission or product-manifest modification.

Prepared explicit-run import continuation uses the original #7026 rows, not the temporary photo row. Helper SHA-256 `2e698f746e1a330597f04774dca3fd4240c76c7ee1cfef21fe537361485a2983`; statically importing worker SHA-256 `9dbcc199a30aa9d0d0d6aa20ca1303faf972a30b41256d38d121bf338d06d648`. It derives compensation from a staged readback, checks all staged seller values against baseline, performs no Move To Live, and refuses a second invocation. A lost mutation response stops for manual inspection without retry or a blind quantity compensation.

Three local synthetic controls passed with zero provider calls: successful round trip, one-row partial upload followed by restoration, and ambiguous upload response causing an explicit stop. CSV parsing includes a quoted multiline field control; capture keys are checked against the closed 14-key schema; redaction controls find neither token nor synthetic exception text. These controls do not establish provider acceptance. The helper is manually invoked from the service-worker console; installation/reload alone performs no request.

Continued live #7026 capture — 2026-09-05, supervised founder session. Partial; canary/rejection still pending.

**exportFromLiveHeader**: Export From Live completed through the browser download handler at approximately 21:47 UTC. Full CSV contains 27,389 records and 16 columns. The three observed rows below redact seller price/quantity and omit photo URLs explicitly; bracketed cells are redactions, not fabricated provider facts.

```csv
TCGplayer Id,Product Line,Set Name,Product Name,Title,Number,Rarity,Condition,TCG Market Price,TCG Direct Low,TCG Low Price With Shipping,TCG Low Price,Total Quantity,Add to Quantity,TCG Marketplace Price,Photo URL
```

```csv
"TCGplayer Id","Product Line","Set Name","Product Name","Title","Number","Rarity","Condition","TCG Market Price","TCG Direct Low","TCG Low Price With Shipping","TCG Low Price","Total Quantity","Add to Quantity","TCG Marketplace Price","Photo URL"
"8584029","Lorcana TCG","Archazia's Island","Aurora - Waking Beauty","","14/204","Legendary","Near Mint","1.46","","2.5900","1.1000","[seller quantity redacted]","0","[seller price redacted]","[omitted]"
"8585104","Lorcana TCG","Archazia's Island","Bagheera - Guardian Jaguar","","198/204","Legendary","Near Mint","1.38","","2.5800","1.0900","[seller quantity redacted]","0","[seller price redacted]","[omitted]"
"8575267","Lorcana TCG","Archazia's Island","Baloo - Ol' Iron Paws","","142/204","Legendary","Near Mint","0.56","","1.8500","0.3600","[seller quantity redacted]","0","[seller price redacted]","[omitted]"
```

**orderSurfaceCapture**: The live order-list UI is on `sellerportal.tcgplayer.com/orders`; it provides Order #, Buyer Name, Order Date, Status, Shipping Type, Product Amt, Shipping Amt, Total Amount, and Actions. An observed real order has an opaque alphanumeric order reference in groups of 8-6-5 characters. Order Date renders month/day/year and 12-hour clock with seconds; no timezone is displayed, so timezone semantics remain unknown. Buyer names and raw order references are omitted. The order reference is exposed separately from Buyer Name; cross-session stability/uniqueness is not inferred.

Export Orders was also captured at approximately 21:51 UTC. Exact header only (no buyer/order data retained in this comment):

```csv
Order #,Buyer Name,Order Date,Status,Shipping Type,Product Amt,Shipping Amt,Total Amt,Buyer Paid,Carrier Information
```

**validation rules page**: https://help.tcgplayer.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001479274-Setting-Prices-for-Your-Channels — TCG Marketplace Price is mandatory; My Store Price is required when My Store Reserve Quantity is greater than zero; Total Quantity is reference-only, and quantity changes use Add to Quantity. Current founder export has no My Store columns. Related observed official import flow: https://help.tcgplayer.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002358027-Importing-and-Exporting-CSVs-to-Mass-Update-Prices-and-Quantities . Exact rejected-row error still pending.

**stagedImportLimits (partial)**: At approximately 21:45 UTC, Import Prices → Step 1: Upload File displayed Choose File and disabled Continue, with no visible numeric file-size/row limit. This captures the initial surface only; no upload-time limit is asserted until an upload can proceed. Do not substitute a documentation literal.

Pre-canary safeguard: Export From Staged captured 32 existing rows at approximately 21:54 UTC. Two existing staged rows and their exact baseline are retained privately for bounded canary/reversion; other staged rows must be preserved. No canary mutation has occurred. Browser file upload is currently waiting for the operator to enable the documented extension file-URL access setting.

### Context

Successor-review R1 F3 on the #7331 successors, split by executor moment per R2 F3: the stopped #7331 body required a "minimum content bridge", the proposed successors dropped it, and neither position has evidence. #7026 captured the Seller Portal import and export surfaces from **page origin** in the founder's browser (form-urlencoded `initializeexportcsv` / `uploadexportcsv` / `finalizeexportcsv` on `store.tcgplayer.com`, cookie **names** including `TCGAuthTicket_Production` and `__RequestVerificationToken_L2FkbWlu0`). Nothing has tested whether a request issued from the extension **service worker** (extension-origin request with host permission, `credentials: "include"`) carries the founder session and satisfies the anti-forgery contract at the import save and export request moments. Chrome documentation proves only that a worker may make cross-origin requests with host permission; it does not prove the provider's session/anti-forgery behaviour for that origin.

This probe decides, for the import and export moments, whether the connector can execute from the worker alone or needs a page-context bridge. The order moment is Probe #7925, which waits for #7793's order-list capture; this probe does not. It reuses #7026's canary rows and redaction rules and duplicates nothing.

Repo evidence:

- #7026 comments 5554920388, 5555055372, 5555154180 — captured hosts, cookie names, upload request shape, canary/revert procedure.
- `docs/runbooks/tcgplayer-automation-operations.md` line 15 — `TCGAuthTicket_Production` is the provider session secret; never captured as a value.
- Successor drafts `goal-7331-extension-plan-repair-g3.brief-b.md` (foundation registers zero provider hosts) and `.brief-bridge.md` (the conditional bridge owner).

### Scope fence

Every artifact is one fenced JSON block per capture with the shape `{ "capture": "<name>", "capturedAt": "<UTC instant ending in Z>", "origin": "worker" | "page", "host": "...", "path": "...", "method": "...", "status": <integer>, "redirected": <bool>, "finalHost": "...", "bodyKind": "html" | "json" | "csv" | "other", "csvRowCount": <non-negative integer|null>, "antiForgeryFieldPresent": <bool>, "jsonTopLevelKeys": [...], "unknown": [...] }`, closed (no other key). Values are field names, statuses, booleans and counts only; no cookie value, header value, body byte, buyer name, order reference or seller identity is ever pasted.

The probe artifact is the throwaway unpacked extension below, loaded from a local folder for the session and removed afterwards. It commits no code, registers no product host and is never built into `deployables/tcgplayer-connector-extension`.

```json
{ "manifest_version": 3, "name": "chase-sets-7331-origin-probe", "version": "0.0.1",
  "background": { "service_worker": "worker.js", "type": "module" },
  "host_permissions": ["https://store.tcgplayer.com/*", "https://sellerportal.tcgplayer.com/*"] }
```

```js
// worker.js — call probe.record(...) from the service-worker console; prints a sanitized record only.
const record = async (capture, url, init = {}) => {
  const r = await fetch(url, { credentials: "include", ...init });
  const ct = r.headers.get("content-type") ?? "";
  const text = await r.text();
  const kind = ct.includes("json") ? "json" : ct.includes("html") ? "html" : ct.includes("csv") ? "csv" : "other";
  let keys = []; try { if (kind === "json") keys = Object.keys(JSON.parse(text)); } catch {}
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ capture, capturedAt: new Date().toISOString(), origin: "worker",
    host: new URL(url).host, path: new URL(url).pathname, method: init.method ?? "GET", status: r.status,
    redirected: r.redirected, finalHost: new URL(r.url).host, bodyKind: kind,
    csvRowCount: kind === "csv" ? text.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).filter(Boolean).length - 1 : null,
    antiForgeryFieldPresent: /name="__RequestVerificationToken"/.test(text), jsonTopLevelKeys: keys, unknown: [] }));
  return text; // returned to the console only so the operator can pass the anti-forgery value to the next call
};
globalThis.probe = { record };
```

In scope, one supervised founder session (may share the #7793 and #7925 session):

1. **Session shape at worker origin.** `probe.record("sessionShapeWorkerOrigin", "https://store.tcgplayer.com/admin/pricing")`. Records whether the worker request lands on the pricing page (200, not redirected to sign-in) and whether the anti-forgery form field is present in the worker-fetched HTML. A redirect or a missing field is recorded, not worked around.
2. **Import moment.** Repeat the #7026 two-row canary **from the worker**: parse the anti-forgery field value from item 1's HTML inside the worker (never printed), then `initializeexportcsv` → `uploadexportcsv` → `finalizeexportcsv` as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` POSTs with the exact #7026 field names, revert with the same path, and confirm by Export From Staged as #7026 did. One negative control: `initializeexportcsv` with the anti-forgery field omitted, recording the refusal status. Abort the whole moment and record `page-required` if item 1 was redirected or fieldless.
3. **Export moment.** First capture the page-origin Export From Live request (host, path, method, field names, whether the response is CSV bytes or a download navigation) — #7026 did not record it — then replay it from the worker. Record `bodyKind` and row count when the worker receives CSV bytes; a navigation/download-only response yields `page-required` unless the replay independently returns bytes.
4. **Verdict.** One `bridgeVerdict` block `{ "import": ..., "export": ... }`, each `worker-sufficient | page-required | unknown`, with the capture names that justify each value; `orders` is deliberately absent (#7925 owns it).

Non-goals: no order-list request (#7925), no code in the repo, no product host in the product manifest, no cookie or header value in evidence, no mutation beyond the reverted two-row canary, no tracking or message write, no message to a buyer, no eBay surface, no third-party telemetry host.

### Decisions already made

- Todd ruling 2026-08-18 (#4388 decision registry): founder-account risk accepted for dogfood; CSV bulk surfaces at human-scale cadence.
- #7328 A.5: exact captured hosts only; `cookies` permission forbidden — this probe uses host permissions and `credentials: "include"` only.
- #7026 closure comment 5557001179: redaction rules and explicit-unknown posture carry forward.

### Defect-class constraints

- `mandated-external-assertion-contradicts-authority` → AC1-AC3: every block carries the exact observed status, redirect and field presence at the named moment; a page-origin fact is never substituted for a worker-origin one.
- `windows-posix-cli-shim-resolves-real-provider-binary` → Operator actions: this probe is operator-run on the founder account; no review or verification lane executes it or inherits its session.
- `closed-schema-shallow-validation` → Verification plan: blocks are closed to the shape above, instants end in `Z`, statuses are integers; a block with an extra key or a date-only instant is rejected at review.
- `presence-evidence-treated-as-completeness` → AC4: a verdict without its justifying capture names, or a capture with an empty `unknown` where a fact was not observed, is incomplete.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Worker-origin request to the pricing page recorded with status, redirect and anti-forgery-field presence. Evidence: `sessionShapeWorkerOrigin`
- [ ] Two-row canary imported and reverted from the worker with the three POST statuses and top-level response keys, plus the omitted-field negative control; or `page-required` with the blocking capture named. Evidence: `importWorkerOrigin`
- [ ] Export From Live request shape captured at page origin and replayed from the worker with `bodyKind` and CSV row count when bytes are returned. Evidence: `exportWorkerOrigin`
- [ ] Two-moment verdict block naming its justifying captures, with every unknown listed explicitly. Evidence: `bridgeVerdict`

### Verification plan

```bash
gh issue view <this issue> --repo chase-sets/chase-sets --comments
```

Each named artifact exists as a comment on this issue, its JSON block parses against the closed shape, no value field carries a cookie, header or body byte, and every unknown is listed explicitly.

### Footprint & chain

Predicted: no repo files change; artifacts attach to this issue. Callers: none. Chain: no native Blocked by. Blocks #7334 and #7336. A `page-required` import verdict makes `E1` Block #7334; a `page-required` export verdict makes it Block #7336; either makes `E1` Blocked by #7921 and this probe. `worker-sufficient` retires the bridge for that moment.

### Operator actions

Todd signs into the founder TCGplayer seller account, loads the probe extension unpacked, runs the three captures from the service-worker console with the retained #7026 canary rows, reverts the canary, verifies Export From Staged equality, removes the probe extension, and attaches the four artifacts. One session, roughly 35 minutes; may share the #7793/#7925 session.

### Glossary impact

none

### External authority probe & evidence timing

This issue is the probe. `sessionShapeWorkerOrigin` at the first worker request; `importWorkerOrigin` at the staged-import save; `exportWorkerOrigin` at the export request; `bridgeVerdict` after all three.

### Review packet seed

not applicable — fast path

Source: `D:\Users\ToddS\Source\Repos\chase-sets\.orchestrator\goal-7331-extension-plan-repair-g3.probe-p2.md`, SHA-256 `d3f0113107a2753418cde7963d49a8d3e1428cbd747abce531561781cb747d2a`. Do not reuse: the combined order moment or its no-blocker claim.
